 "content": "def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    line_r = next(r for r, row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg)
    line_color = g[line_r][0]
    pts = [(r, c, g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg, line_color)]
    if not pts:
        return g
    # Move the colored object toward the full-width divider until it touches it.
    rs = [p[0] for p in pts]
    if max(rs) < line_r:
        dr = line_r - 1 - max(rs)  # object remains above divider
    elif min(rs) > line_r:
        dr = line_r + 1 - min(rs)  # object remains below divider
    else:
        dr = 0
    for r, c, _ in pts:
        g[r][c] = bg
    for r, c, color in pts:
        g[r + dr][c] = color
    g[line_r] = [8] * w
    return g
"
